apiCaptures.name: frankencoin-info
apiCaptures.note: chainSupply values keyed by chain name from the API's chainId map (1, 8453, 100, 42161, 10, 137, 43114, 146); they sum to the reported total supply 34139468.8738245. The ethereum-mainnet figure 30429960.649122458 matches the journaled eth_call totalSupply() at block 25538909 to 8 decimals.

apiCaptures.name: collateral-positions-details
apiCaptures.note: Open, non-denied position collateral balances valued with the protocol price mapping below; method reproduces the 2026-07-17 and 2026-07-15 reserveReview captures.

apiCaptures.name: prices-mapping
apiCaptures.note: CHF prices per collateral address; every active collateral line had a mapped price (no missing prices).

computedCollateralChf.method: sum over open, non-denied positions of collateralBalance x price-mapping CHF price
computedCollateralChf.crossCheck: The protocol API's own TVL figure is 56689834.48 CHF (0.92% above this computation); total supply 34139468.87 ZCHF exceeds position-minted 33538709.88 ZCHF by ~601k ZCHF, the amount minted through the stablecoin bridges (XCHF/VCHF/CHFAU), which hold locked source stablecoins instead of position collateral.

calls.name: frankencoin.totalSupply
calls.note: Matches the API ethereum-mainnet supply 30429960.649122458 (rounding in the last decimal).

calls.name: frankencoin.equity
calls.note: Per the pinned Frankencoin.sol source, equity() = balanceOf(reserve) - minterReserve(): the free equity owned by FPS holders.

calls.name: frankencoin.minterReserve
calls.note: Reserve attributable to minters (position owners' reserve contributions); per the source it covers losses after equity holders are wiped out.

calls.name: frankencoin.reserve
calls.note: Equity/FPS contract, unchanged from the 2026-07-17 capture.

derivedMetrics.collateralizationRatioMethod: computedCollateralChf.totalValueChf / total supply (56170191.00 / 34139468.8738245); conservative variant against position-minted debt only is 1.674787; protocol-TVL variant is 1.660537.

reservePoolCoverage.method: equity() + minterReserve() at block 25538909 = balanceOf(reserve pool)
reservePoolCoverage.note: Loss-absorption capital, not committed liquidation capacity; Frankencoin liquidations clear through externally funded challenge auctions.

ccipBridgedShare.protocolApiMethod: 1 - ethereum-mainnet supply / total supply from the 2026-07-19 info capture
ccipBridgedShare.defiLlamaPipelineMethod: sum of non-Ethereum chainCirculatingById.current / totalSupplyUsd from the 2026-07-18 replay fixedInput (all seven non-Ethereum deployments are Chainlink CCIP burn/mint)
